blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Developing on-device image models requires considering practical user needs, task types and device resource constraints. However, existing benchmarks provide limited guidance on identifying capability gaps between on-device models and server-side models. We introduce MoI-Bench, a benchmark grounded in mobile user needs, comprising 64 subtasks and 1150 samples. It defines 16 operations, such as removal and replacement, and eight visual target categories covering content such as portraits and text. These form two orthogonal axes whose applicable combinations define specific tasks, such as removing facial makeup. To better guide model improvement, we further propose MoI-Eval, which introduces task-specific criteria covering instruction following, visual quality and detail preservation. We further construct sample-level evaluation questions and aggregate their scores into overall quality and capability profiles along the operation, target and criteria axes. We evaluate representative on-device and server-side models and measure mobile deployment costs. Results show that this decoupled Operation x Target design provides finer-grained guidance for improving compact models. For example, it highlights the need to prioritize specific capability gaps (e.g., text-replacement) over broad application-level goals (e.g., improving text editing). Unlike conventional benchmarks that rank models using a single score, we introduce a two-dimensional Quality-Deployability capability map to assess models for practical mobile use. The map shows that current on-device models can achieve efficient generation or editing but expanding their task coverage deserves greater attention than further improving deployment efficiency. Further progress requires improving editing quality, particularly identity preservation and text rendering, while broadening task coverage.
blocks.zh: 开发在线图像模型需要考虑实际用户需求,任务类型以及设备资源限制. 然而,现有基准在查明安装设备模型和服务器侧模型之间能力差距方面提供了有限的指导。 我们介绍了MoI-Bench,这是基于移动用户需求的基准,由64个子任务和1150个样本组成. 它定义了去除和替换等16个操作,并定义了涵盖肖像和文字等内容的8个视觉目标类别. 这些组成了两个正交轴,其适用的组合定义了具体的任务,例如去除面部化妆. 为了更好地指导模型的改进,我们进一步提出MOI-Eval,它引入了针对特定任务的标准,包括后续指令,视觉质量和细节保存. 我们进一步构建抽样评价问题,并沿业务、目标和标准轴将其分数汇总为总体质量和能力概况。 我们评价具有代表性的安装模型和服务器侧模型,并衡量移动部署费用。 结果表明,这种脱钩行动x目标设计为改进紧凑模型提供了更精细的指导. 例如,它强调需要将具体能力差距(如文本替换)放在广泛的应用层面目标(如改进文本编辑)之上。 与使用一分制对模型进行排序的常规基准不同,我们引入了二维质量-可部署性能力图,以评估模型用于实际移动使用. 地图显示,目前的设备模型可以实现高效的生成或编辑,但扩大其任务范围比进一步提高部署效率更值得注意。 要取得进一步进展,就必须提高编辑质量,特别是身份保存和文本制作,同时扩大任务范围。

blocks.en: 1 INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of our benchmark and evaluation framework: (a) tasks grounded in mobile user needs; (b) structured capability evaluation along operation, target and criteria axes; and (c) model improvement guided by the Quality-Deployability map.

blocks.en:
Advances in large diffusion models have improved image generation and editing capabilities Cai et al. (2025) ; Feng et al. (2026b) ; Liu et al. (2026) , with increasing use in mobile photo-editing applications.
Cloud-based services such as GPT Image 2.5 OpenAI (2026) and Seedream 5.0 ByteDance Seed (2026) bring substantial inference costs and raise privacy concerns over personal image uploads.
These concerns have motivated the development of compact on-device models, such as SnapGen, Mobile-O, DreamLite and so on Shaker et al. (2026) ; Duan et al. (2026) ; Deng et al. (2026) ; Chen et al. (2025a) .
Evaluating these models requires determining which mobile tasks they support, how well their outputs satisfy user requirements, and whether inference fits device resource budgets.
However, existing benchmarks such as GenEval Ghosh et al. (2023) and ImgEdit-Bench Ye et al. (2026) primarily assess general generation and editing capabilities.
They provide limited guidance on connecting mobile application needs, task performance and on-device deployment costs.
This makes it difficult for developers to select models for specific requests and for researchers to identify capability gaps relative to larger models.
blocks.zh:
大型传播模型的进展提高了Cai等人(2025年);Feng等人(2026年b)的图像生成和编辑能力; 刘等人(2026年),在移动摄影编辑应用中应用越来越多.
基于云的服务如GPT Image 2.5 OpenAI(2026)和Seedream 5.0 ByteDance Seed(2026)带来了大量的推论成本,并引起了个人图像上传的隐私关切.
这些关注促使开发了紧凑的安装模型,例如SnapGen,Mobile-O,DreamLite等关于Shaker等人(2026年);Duan等人(2026年);Deng等人(2026年);Chen等人(2025年a).
评价这些模型需要确定它们支持哪些移动任务,其产出如何满足用户要求,以及推断是否符合设备资源预算。
然而,GenEval Ghosh等人(2023年)和ImgEdit-Bench Ye等人(2026年)等现有基准主要评估一般生成和编辑能力。
它们就移动应用需要、任务执行情况和安装设备的部署费用提供了有限的指导。
这使得开发者难以为具体请求选择模型,也难以让研究人员确定相对于较大模型的能力差距.

blocks.en:
A request such as removing text from a picture specifies both an action and the visual content it concerns.
We define the requested action, such as removal or replacement, as the operation , and the type of visual content to generate or modify as the target .
Integrating more general application categories such as Text Editing can extend coverage of mobile scenarios but does not always make the task coverage explicit.
For example, Text Editing can include both text removal and text replacement, so a high category score of Text Editing does not establish proficiency in both operations.
Conversely, removing text and removing a person share the same operation applied to different targets.
Grouping scores only by application category makes it difficult to compare removal capability across targets and between on-device and server-side models.
We therefore introduce MoI-Bench , a Mo bile I mage generation and editing Benchmark grounded in a user survey of mobile application needs.
Fig. 1 illustrates how we connect these needs to structured capability evaluation and model improvement.
We define most operations following prior works Jiang et al. (2026) ; Jia et al. (2026) , then use a user survey to identify priority target categories for mobile applications.
It defines 16 operations and eight target categories as two orthogonal axes of an Operation × \times Target Task Matrix.
Applicable combinations are manually reviewed, yielding 64 subtasks comprising 1150 samples.
This organization supports comparisons between operations for the same target and between targets for the same operation, helping developers assess the requests relevant to their applications.
blocks.zh:
从图片中删除文本等请求既指定了动作,也指定了它所涉及的视觉内容.
我们定义了请求的动作,例如移除或替换,作为操作,以及作为目标生成或修改的视觉内容的类型.
整合文本编辑等更一般的应用类别可以扩大移动情景的涵盖范围,但并不总是明确任务涵盖范围.
例如,"文本编辑"既可以包括文字去除,也可以包括文字替换,因此"文本编辑"的高分类分数并不能确立两种操作的熟练程度.
反之,删除文本和删除一个人则共享适用于不同目标的相同操作.
仅仅按应用程序类别分组得分,就很难在目标之间以及服务器端模型之间进行比较。
因此我们推出MoI-Bench, 即Mobile I mage生成和编辑基准,
图1说明了我们如何将这些需求与结构化的能力评估和模型改进联系起来。
我们定义了之前的作品Jiang等人(2026年);Jia等人(2026年)之后的大多数操作,然后使用用户调查来确定移动应用的优先目标类别.
它将16个操作和8个目标类别定义为一个操作×\times目标任务矩阵的两个正交轴.

blocks.en:
Task performance alone does not explain which output requirements a model fails to satisfy.
When asked to remove a specified person from a group portrait, a model may remove the wrong person, alter the remaining people’s identities or leave visible artifacts.
Then we propose MoI-Eval , which associates each subtask with applicable criteria ( i.e. , instruction following, visual quality and detail preservation) in a sparse Operation × \times Target × \times Criteria Rubric Cube.
Based on these criteria, we develop detailed questions for each sample to evaluate models’ outputs and aggregate their scores into overall quality Q Q and capability profiles along operation , target and criteria .
Joint Operation × \times Target profiles show performance on specific requests, while criterion profiles help researchers identify whether improvements are needed in instruction following, visual quality or preservation of existing details.
blocks.zh:
单凭任务业绩并不能解释模型未能满足哪些产出要求。
当被要求将特定的人从团体肖像中移除时,一个模型可能会移除错误的人,改变剩下的人的身份或者留下可见的文物.
然后我们提议MoI-Eval, 将每个子任务与适用的标准联系起来(即后续指令,视觉质量和细节保存),
根据这些标准,我们为每个样本制定详细问题,以评估模型的产出,并将其分数汇总到总体质量Q和按业务、目标和标准划分的能力概况中。
Joint Operation ×\times 目标剖面图显示在特定请求上的性能,而标准剖面图则帮助研究者确定在后续指令,视觉质量或保存现有细节方面是否需要改进.

blocks.en:
For mobile applications, output quality must also be considered alongside deployment costs.
Even high-quality models are unsuitable for on-device use if their memory requirements exceed device capacity.
We therefore retain quality Q Q and deployability D D as separate dimensions in a Quality-Deployability capability map.
The quality dimension considers the overall score Q Q , task coverage and criterion-group scores, while the deployability dimension considers end-to-end latency, peak memory and deployed model size.
Based on these measurements, we define quality tiers and deployability tiers and use them to construct a Quality-Deployability capability map.
The map positions models by capability and resource requirements, helping developers select suitable models and researchers identify priorities for broader task coverage, higher output quality or lower deployment costs.
blocks.zh:
对于移动应用程序,还必须考虑到产出质量和部署费用。
即使是高质量的模型,如果内存要求超过设备容量,也不适合在设备上使用.
因此,我们保留了质量QQ和可部署性DD,作为质量-可部署性能力图的单独维度。
质量维度考虑整体分数QQ,任务覆盖范围和标准组分,而可部署维度考虑端到端延迟,顶峰内存和部署模型大小.
根据这些测量,我们界定了质量等级和可部署等级,并利用这些等级来构建质量-可部署能力图。
地图定位模型根据能力和资源需求,帮助开发人员选择合适的模型,研究人员确定优先事项,以扩大任务覆盖面,提高产出质量或降低部署成本。

blocks.en:
We evaluate 19 generative models and measure text-to-image deployment costs on iOS and Android devices.
Our results first show that MoI-Bench provides finer-grained and clearer guidance for model improvement.
For example, Ovis-U1 Wang et al. (2025a) achieves comparable performance with FLUX.2 [klein] Black Forest Labs (2026) on text removal but falls far behind on text replacement.
This challenges the assumption that compact models perform poorly across all text-related tasks and suggests that improving specific tasks ( e.g. , text replacement) should take priority over text editing in general.
This distinction also helps users select models for their intended purposes.
Criterion profiles further distinguish on-device models’ development priorities: DreamLite Feng et al. (2026a) shows weaknesses in visual integrity and coherence, whereas Ovis-U1 has a lower identity-preservation score.
Additionally, our findings suggest that broadening task coverage deserves greater attention than further optimizing mobile deployment efficiency.
Models such as BlazeEdit Deng et al. (2026) and Moebius Duan et al. (2026) support only a single editing task, while even more general editing models such as DreamLite Feng et al. (2026a) lack support for multiple input images.
Mobile-O and DreamLite both reach D3 on the iPhone 17 Pro, but their reference quality tiers are Q1 and Q2, respectively.
Further progress therefore requires improving editing quality and expanding task coverage while preserving resource efficiency.
The task-dependent capability gaps also motivate exploring on-device–cloud routing, with requests assigned according to model capability and deployment constraints.
blocks.zh:
我们评价19个基因模型,并衡量iOS和Android设备的文本到图像部署费用。
我们的结果显示,MOI-Bench为模型改进提供了更精细和更清晰的指导。
例如,Ovis-U1 Wang et al. (2025a)在文本去除方面与FLUX.2[klein]黑森林实验室(2026年)取得了相似的性能,但在文本替换方面却远远落后.
这对紧凑模式在所有与文本有关的任务中表现不佳这一假设提出了挑战,并建议改进具体任务(例如替换文本)应比一般文本编辑优先。
这种区分也帮助用户为预期目的选择模型.
标准简介进一步区分各模型的发展优先事项: 梦想点缀 Feng等人(2026a)在视觉完整性和一致性方面表现出弱点,而Ovis-U1的识别-保全分数较低.
此外,我们的调查结果表明,扩大任务范围比进一步优化流动部署效率更值得注意。
模型如BlazeEdit Deng等人(2026年)和Moebius Duan等人. (2026)只支持单一编辑任务,而DreamLite Feng等人(2026a)等更通用的编辑模式则缺乏对多个输入图像的支持.
Mobile-O和DreamLite均在iPhone 17 Pro上达到D3,但其参考质量等级分别为Q1和Q2.
因此,要取得进一步进展,就必须提高编辑质量和扩大任务范围,同时保持资源效率。
取决于任务的能力差距也促使人们探索在线-云层路径,根据模型能力和部署限制分配请求。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • We introduce MoI-Bench , a benchmark for on-device image models, built on an Operation × \times Target Task Matrix. Its 1,150 samples span 64 subtasks designed around mobile application needs, covering image generation and four types of editing operations. • We propose MoI-Eval , which derives overall quality Q Q and capability profiles along the operation, target, and criteria axes from a sparse Operation × \times Target × \times Criteria Rubric Cube. It further introduces, to the best of our knowledge, the first unified Quality-Deployability capability map for benchmarking models instead of a single score. • We benchmark representative generative models and further examine Quality-Deployability trade-offs for on-device models through measurements on iOS and Android devices. We release the license-audited benchmark annotations, inference code and evaluation toolkit.

blocks.en:
To better align the benchmark with real-world mobile user needs, we survey 1,000 participants to guide task scope and target coverage.
As shown in Fig. 2 (a), portrait retouching, object removal, photo restoration and text editing are the most common desired uses.
These preferences motivate an emphasis on image editing, while text-to-image generation is retained to assess models’ basic image-generation capabilities.
The reported use cases guide our selection of targets and operations, whose applicable combinations define subtasks such as blemish adjustment and photobomb removal.
User priorities motivate criteria for instruction following, identity preservation and visual quality.
We refine these requirements into task-specific criteria and sample-level evaluation questions.
Preferences for quick results, low storage use and avoiding device slowdown further motivate our deployment measurements of latency, model size and peak memory.
Survey details are provided in the Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh:
为了更好地使基准与现实世界的移动用户需求保持一致,我们调查了1 000名参与者,以指导任务范围和目标覆盖面。
如图2(a)所示,肖像重修、取出物体、照片修复和文本编辑是最常用的用途。
这些偏好促使人们强调图像编辑,同时保留文字到图像生成,以评估模型的基本图像生成能力。
所报告的使用案例指导我们选择目标和行动,其适用的组合界定了诸如污点调整和光弹清除等子任务。
用户的优先次序激励着遵循教学标准、身份保护和视觉质量。
我们把这些要求细化为具体任务标准和抽样评价问题。

blocks.en: Following prior taxonomies Yu et al. (2025) ; Ye et al. (2026) , we organize 16 operation units into five groups (Tab. 1 ):

blocks.en:
• Generation. Creating an image from a prompt without an input image.
Tasks specify the desired subjects, attributes, composition and style.
Generation conditioned on a reference image is assigned to Reference Editing. • Local Editing. Adding, removing, replacing or adjusting specified content while preserving unrelated regions.
Addition introduces new content, while removal deletes selected content and reconstructs the exposed region.
Replacement substitutes content, such as replacing a hairstyle or a word.
Adjustment changes attributes of existing content, such as color, size, position or pose. • Global Editing. Changing overall appearance or scene context through stylization, background modification, restoration or camera-view changes.
Stylization applies a visual style across the image, while background modification changes the surroundings and preserves the foreground subject.
Restoration addresses degradation such as blur, noise or overexposure, including localized defects.
Camera-view changes alter the viewing perspective rather than individual object positions. • Understanding Editing. Inferring the required change or completing content from semantic and visual context.
Semantic editing requires interpreting an intended outcome rather than an explicitly prescribed visual change, such as showing what happens to ice cream left in the sun.
Inpainting reconstructs missing content within a supplied mask using the surrounding image.
Outpainting extends content beyond the original image boundaries while maintaining scene consistency. • Reference Editing. Using reference images to specify desired content or attributes, such as identity, pose, clothing or style.
Following prior work Oshima et al. (2026) , we organize these tasks by input configuration.
A single reference without a base image guides the generation of a new image.
A base image with one reference supports transferring specified content or attributes into the base image.
Configurations with two or three references combine information from multiple sources, with each reference assigned a role in the instruction.

blocks.en:
• General Objects. This group contains Concrete Objects and Abstract Objects.
Concrete Objects include vehicles, furniture and everyday items.
Abstract Objects cover visual effects and relations, such as lighting, shadows and reflections. • Animals. This category covers animals, including pets, their appearance and their accessories.
Tasks include generating animals, modifying their pose or fur, and adding or removing accessories such as collars. • Portraits. This group contains four categories: Body & Limbs, Face & Hair, Clothing & Accessories, and Multi-Subjects.
Body & Limbs covers body shape, limb configuration and pose.
Face & Hair covers facial features, expressions, makeup, hairstyles and identity.
Clothing & Accessories covers garments and worn items, such as coats, glasses and jewelry.
Multi-Subjects covers groups of people, including group-level changes and edits to selected individuals within a group.
Examples include adding or removing a person and changing the pose of a specified individual while preserving the others. • Text & Documents. This category covers text content and its visual presentation in documents, posters, signs and other text-bearing images.
Tasks include adding, removing, replacing or translating text, as well as modifying typography and layout.
It also includes restoring document clarity and correcting page perspective.

blocks.en:
We construct subtasks by pairing operations with target categories.
For example, Replacement × \times Text & Documents replaces specified text while retaining the surrounding content and layout.
We also manually review the applicability of each operation × \times target combination.
For example, Addition × \times Body & Limbs is marked N/A because adding anatomical parts falls outside our portrait-editing scope.
Operations are adapted to practical target-specific needs ( e.g. , camera-view editing becomes perspective rectification for documents rather than viewpoint changes in general scenes).
We also group target categories under a shared subtask when they follow the same task definition ( e.g. , stylization of the whole image).
Reference editing with two or three reference images also uses shared subtasks to combine information from multiple sources.
Each merged cell counts as one subtask, yielding 64 subtasks in total (Tab. 1 ).
Detailed task descriptions and examples are provided in the Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh:
我们通过将操作与目标类别配对来构建子任务.
例如,替换x\times文本和文档在保留周围内容和布局的同时替换指定的文本.
我们还手动审查每个操作x\时间目标组合的适用性.
例如,添加 ×\times body & Limbs 被标记为N/A,因为添加解剖部分不属于我们的肖像编辑范围.
操作是适应实际的特定目标需要的(例如,相机-视图编辑变成了对文件的视角矫正,而不是一般场景中的观点变化).
我们还在遵循相同的任务定义(如整个图像的系统化)时,将目标类别归入一个共同子任务下.
带有两三个参考图像的参考编辑也使用共享的子任务来结合来自多个来源的信息.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset Construction and Quality Control
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集建设与质量控制

blocks.en:
Following ImgEdit-Bench Ye et al. (2026) , we construct samples through subtask-level allocation, image selection and instruction refinement.
Within each subtask, we first identify the specific transformations and target variations to cover and assign an initial sample quota.
For example, ( B 1 + R 1 ) × (B1+R1)\times Face&Hair includes hairstyle, makeup and facial identity transfer.
We allocate approximately five samples to each transformation, giving 15 samples for this subtask.
These quotas guide image collection and are adjusted after reviewing image and instruction diversity
blocks.zh:
追随 ImgEdit- Bench Ye等人(2026年),我们通过子任务级别分配、图像选择和指导改进来构建样本。
在每一个子任务中,我们首先确定具体的转变和目标变化,以涵盖和分配初步的抽样配额。
例如, (B 1 + R 1) × (B1 + R1)\ times Face&Hair包括发型,化妆和面部身份转移.
我们为每个变换分配了大约5个样本,为这个子任务提供了15个样本.
这些配额指导图像收集,并在审查图像和教学多样性后进行调整。

blocks.en:
Subsequently, we retrieve input and reference images from Pexels and Wikimedia Commons.
Images are selected to provide the visual information needed for the requested task, such as visible facial features for makeup editing or readable text for text replacement.
For reference editing, we review the base and reference images together to ensure that the specified transfer is feasible and that each image has a clear role.
For inpainting and restoration, we apply predefined masks or degradations to the source images.
All evaluated models receive the same processed inputs.
blocks.zh:
随后,我们从Pexels和Wikimedia Commons检索输入和参考图像。
选择图像是为了提供所请求的任务所需的视觉信息,如化妆编辑的可见面部特征或文本替换的可读文本.
为了进行参考编辑,我们共同审查基准和参考图像,以确保指定的传输是可行的,每个图像都有明确的作用。
对于涂装和修复,我们对源图像使用预先定义的口罩或降解.
所有经评价的模型都得到同样的加工投入。

blocks.en:
Given the subtask and selected images, Gemini 3.1 Pro Google (2026) proposes instruction templates.
We manually select and adapt these templates to each sample, specifying the requested change, its target and any content that should remain unchanged.
For tasks with multiple input images, instructions also identify the role of each reference.
Text-to-image samples contain only prompts describing the desired image, without input images.
Two annotators cross-review each sample for instruction clarity, task feasibility and consistency with the input images.
They also check for duplicates and review visual and instruction diversity within each subtask.
The final subtask sample counts are provided in Tab. 14 in the Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh:
考虑到子任务和选定的图像,双子座3.1 Pro Google(2026)提出了指令模板.
我们手动选择和调整这些模板,使之适应每个样本,具体说明要求的更改、目标和任何应保持不变的内容。
对于有多个输入图像的任务,指令也会识别每个引用的作用.
文本到图像样本只包含描述想要的图像的提示,没有输入图像.
两个注释员对每个样本进行交叉审查,以了解指示的清晰度、任务的可行性以及与输入图像的一致性。
他们还检查复制品,审查每个子任务中的视觉和教学多样性。
最后的子任务抽样数载于附录A.2的Tab.14。

blocks.en:
Following prior work Ye et al. (2026) ; Jiang et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2023) , two annotators cross-review each sample for instruction clarity, task feasibility and image–instruction consistency.
They check whether the instruction clearly identifies the requested change and its target, and whether the input images provide the information needed to perform the task.
For reference editing, they inspect all inputs together and check that the role of each reference is clearly specified.
For text-to-image generation, they review the prompt for clarity and consistency with the assigned subtask.
We also check for duplicate samples and review visual and instruction diversity within each subtask.
This review informs instruction refinement and adjustments to sample allocation.
blocks.zh:
以往工作之后 Ye et al. (2026); Jiang et al. (2026); Zhang et al. (2023), 两位注释员对每个样本进行交叉审查,以确定指令清晰度,任务可行性和图像-指令一致性.
它们检查指令是否明确识别了所要求的更改及其目标,以及输入图像是否提供了完成任务所需的信息.
为了编辑参考文献,他们检查所有投入,检查每个参考文献的作用是否明确。
对于文本到图像生成,他们审查是否及时清晰,并与指定的子任务保持一致.
我们还检查重复样本,审查每个子任务中的视觉和教学多样性。
这一审查为改进指示和调整抽样分配提供了依据。

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 2 (d), MoI-Bench includes 150 text-to-image samples, 898 single-image samples and 102 multi-image samples.
Single-image samples comprise 860 direct-editing cases and 38 reference-only cases.
Multi-image samples use one base image with one, two or three reference images, comprising 82, 12 and 8 cases, respectively.
We limit reference inputs to three images to keep the benchmark focused on mobile use under resource constraints.

blocks.en:
We summarize task categories used in prior benchmarks to define the comparison dimensions in Tab. 2 .
These dimensions cover text-to-image generation, local and global editing, pose and spatial changes, viewpoint changes, implicit editing and multi-object editing.

blocks.en: 4.1 Quality Rubric Cube

blocks.en:
We extend the Operation × \times Target Task Matrix with a criteria axis to form a Quality Rubric Cube .
Each applicable cell specifies the evaluation requirements for an operation × \times target combination under one criterion.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个标准轴来扩展“目标任务矩阵”行动,以形成一个高质量的Rubric立方体。
每一个适用的单元格都具体说明在一个标准下对一个操作x\时间目标组合的评价要求。

blocks.en:
Following ImgEdit-Bench Ye et al. (2026) , we organize evaluation into three criterion groups: instruction following, visual quality and detail preservation.
These groups contain eight criteria that form the third axis of the rubric cube:
blocks.zh:
追随 ImgEdit- Bench Ye等人(2026年),我们把评估分为三个标准类别:以下指令、视觉质量和细节保存。
这些组包含8个标准,构成块立方体的第三轴:

blocks.en:
• Instruction Following (IF) : It assesses whether the output satisfies the requested operation and its constraints. Fidelity checks whether the intended outcome is achieved, including specified attributes, relations and reference conditions. Selection checks whether the operation targets the correct region or instance, such as the leftmost person in a group rather than another person. • Visual Quality (VQ) : It assesses the visual quality of the generated or edited image. Integrity checks whether generated or modified content has complete shapes and is free from distortions, malformed parts and artifacts. Coherence checks consistency within the output and between edited regions and their surroundings, including boundaries, textures and lighting. Presentation assesses whole-image quality, including readability, composition and physical plausibility. • Detail Preservation (DP) : It assesses whether content and attributes outside the requested change remain preserved. Context checks non-target objects, animals and background details. Structure checks framing and spatial relations, including poses and positions that should remain unchanged.
Given the demand for identity preservation in our user survey, Identity explicitly checks human identity and appearance features not targeted by the instruction.
Preservation requirements exclude changes requested by the user; for example, hairstyle replacement should preserve facial identity but not the original hairstyle.

We then manually mark each entry as always applicable, sample-dependent, or not applicable.
For text-to-image generation, all three DP criteria are inapplicable because no source image is provided.
For object editing, Identity is sample-dependent and applies only when the input contains people whose identities should be preserved.
These applicability labels define the sparse rubric cube.
For each sample, we include always-applicable entries and resolve sample-dependent entries using its instruction and input images.
Non-applicable entries are excluded from evaluation.

This distinction supports model selection for individual requests rather than relying on a broad text-editing score.

blocks.en: 4.3 Quality-Deployability Map
blocks.zh: 4.3 质量-可调动性地图

blocks.en:
The quality score Q Q measures output quality but does not account for the time and resources required for mobile inference.
We assess deployability using end-to-end latency, peak memory and deployed model size.
These metrics capture waiting time, runtime memory usage and storage requirements in mobile use.
We therefore present quality and deployability on separate axes in the Quality-Deployability Map .
blocks.zh:
质量分数QQ衡量产出质量,但不考虑移动推论所需的时间和资源.
我们利用端到端的耐久性、峰值内存和部署的模型大小来评估可部署性。
这些度量衡捕捉了等待时间,运行时间内存使用和移动使用中的存储要求.
因此,我们在质量-可部署性地图中将质量和可部署性放在不同的轴上。

blocks.en:
Mobile deployment involves model-specific quantization, operator adaptation and runtime optimization.
Differences in model architecture and device support make it difficult to apply an identical optimization procedure across different models.
We therefore evaluate the resource costs of deployed configurations from a mobile user’s perspective: storage requirements, waiting time and runtime memory usage.
Our protocol accommodates model-specific deployment optimizations and measures the resulting deployment costs using consistent metrics.
blocks.zh:
移动部署涉及模型特定量化,操作员适应和运行时间优化.
模型架构和器件支持的差异使得不同模型之间难以应用相同的优化程序.
因此,我们从移动用户的角度评价部署配置的资源成本:存储要求、等待时间和运行时间内存使用。
我们的规程包含针对具体模型的部署优化,并使用一致的衡量标准衡量由此造成的部署费用。

blocks.en:
A deployment configuration specifies model weights, component precisions, inference settings and runtime.
We report three metrics: • Model Size. Total storage required for standalone inference, including the backbone, image decoder, required encoders and supporting inference files.
Shared files are counted once; duplicate artifacts and development files are excluded. • Inference Latency. End-to-end time covering prompt processing, text encoding, generation, image decoding and post-processing.
Initial model loading, warm-up and result-file writing are excluded.
Loading and offloading performed during generation remain part of the measured latency. • Peak Memory. Maximum sampled application memory within each inference run, averaged across runs.
We use application physical footprint on iOS and process proportional set size (PSS) on Android, reporting the two platform-specific measurements separately. Storage and memory are reported in MiB.
Failed and unmeasured configurations are distinguished.
Devices, workloads, precision settings and measurement procedures are detailed in the experimental setup.
blocks.zh:

我们报告三个标准:模型大小。 独立推论所需的总存储,包括主干线,图像解码器,需要编码器和支持推论文件.

我们使用iOS上的应用物理脚印和Android上的处理比例设定尺寸(PSS),分别报告两个平台特定的测量. 存储和内存在MiB中报告.

Initial model loading, warm-up and result-file writing are excluded.
Loading and offloading performed during generation remain part of the measured latency.

We use application physical footprint on iOS and process proportional set size (PSS) on Android, reporting the two platform-specific measurements separately.

blocks.en:
Alongside quality tiers, we define deployability tiers D1–D4 using the joint requirements in Tab. 3 .
D1 denotes unavailable local deployment under the tested conditions, including deployment failure, invalid output, cloud- or API-only access, or a model that is too large for the target device.
D2 requires successful execution, while D3 and D4 impose progressively tighter latency, storage and memory limits.
D4 is the highest tier, designed to represent responsive mobile inference with modest resource requirements.
These tiers assess the deployment outcome achieved by a model and its implementation on a specified device, allowing improvements from hardware and runtime optimization to be reflected in its rating.
Thresholds are shared across devices, models and precision settings.
blocks.zh:
除了质量等级之外,我们使用Tab中的联合要求来定义可部署等级D1-D4。 页:1
D1表示在测试条件下无法进行本地部署,包括部署失败,无效输出,只访问云或API,或者一个对目标设备来说太大的模型.
D2需要成功执行,而D3和D4则规定了逐渐更紧的延迟,存储和内存限制.
D4是最高的一级,旨在代表响应性移动推论和适度的资源需求.
这些级别评估一个模型的部署结果及其在指定设备上的实施,从而能够将硬件和运行时间优化的改进反映在其评级中。
阈值在设备,模型和精密设置之间共享.

blocks.en:
For the baseline comparison, we do not introduce bespoke operator adaptations or additional model-specific performance optimizations beyond those required to execute the models.
Among the evaluated models, DreamLite is the only model for which we successfully deployed editing on-device.
We therefore use text-to-image generation as the common deployment task supported by all evaluated on-device models.
blocks.zh:
为了进行基线比较,我们不采用标定操作员的调整,也不采用超出执行模型所需程度的额外模型特定性能优化。
在被评价的模型中,DreamLite是我们成功在设备上部署编辑的唯一模型.
因此,我们使用文本到图像生成作为共同部署任务,得到所有评估的文本模型的支持。

blocks.en:
We first manually define initial thresholds for quality and deployability tiers.
For quality tiers, we compare assignments obtained from GPT-4o and Gemini 3.1 Pro, identify disagreements, and iteratively adjust the shared thresholds to improve agreement while preserving meaningful distinctions between capability levels.
For deployability tiers, we compare assignments for matched deployment configurations on two devices with comparable hardware capabilities and calibrate the shared thresholds to reduce cross-device discrepancies.
The resulting thresholds are fixed for all reported comparisons and listed in Tab. 3 .
Sensitivity analyses are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
我们首先手动确定质量和可部署级别的初步阈值。
就质量等级而言,我们比较从GPT-4o和双子座3.1 Pro获得的任务,找出分歧,并反复调整共同阈值,以改进协议,同时保持能力等级之间的有意义的区别。
就可部署级别而言,我们比较了两个具有类似硬件能力的设备上匹配部署配置的任务,并校准了共同的阈值,以减少交叉设备差异。
由此得出的阈值是对所有报告比较的固定的,并在Tab中列出。 页:1
补充材料中提供了敏感性分析。

blocks.en:
Evaluating an on-device model requires considering both quality and deployability.
High quality cannot compensate for unsuccessful deployment, while low latency cannot compensate for insufficient task capability.
We therefore retain these dimensions as separate axes rather than combining them into a single score.
The Quality-Deployability capability map places reference quality tiers from Sec. 4.2 on the horizontal axis and device-specific deployability tiers on the vertical axis.
The upper-right region represents the goal of an on-device flagship model, combining high quality, broad task coverage and efficient mobile execution.
The lower-right region represents high-quality models with limited mobile deployability, including server-side models accessed through cloud APIs.
The map thus indicates whether model development should prioritize quality and task coverage, deployment efficiency, or both.
blocks.zh:
评价一个备用模型需要既考虑质量,也考虑可部署性。
高质量不能弥补部署失败,而低延迟不能弥补任务能力不足。
因此,我们保留这些方面作为单独的轴线,而不是将它们合并为一个分数。
质量-部署能力图将来自Sec.4.2的参考质量级置于水平轴上,将设备特定部署级置于垂直轴上.
上右翼区域代表着一个在线旗舰模式的目标,将高质量,广泛的任务覆盖范围和高效的移动执行结合起来.
右下角区域代表了具有有限移动部署能力的高质量模型,包括通过云端API访问的服务器侧模型.
因此,地图表明,模型开发应优先考虑质量和任务覆盖面、部署效率,还是两者兼而有之。

blocks.en:
A complementary scatter plot presents continuous quality scores against end-to-end mobile latency.
Color indicates task coverage, and bubble area represents total parameter count.
Models without successful mobile inference are displayed separately without latency coordinates.
Together, these views show each model’s position and the measured differences behind its tier assignment.
blocks.zh:
一个互补的散块图呈现出连续的质量分数,相对于端到端的移动延迟.
颜色表示任务覆盖度,泡区代表总参数计数.
没有成功移动推论的模型在没有延迟坐标的情况下单独显示.
这些观点共同表明每个模式的立场及其等级分配的差别。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate 19 representative models, including 16 open-weight models and three closed-source models.
Given the limited availability of lightweight models, we include widely used and recently released larger models as quality references.
The evaluated models are listed in Tab. 4 .
We access GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2 and Seedream 5.0 Pro through their APIs.
blocks.zh:
我们评价19个代表性模型,包括16个开放量级模型和3个封闭源代码模型.
鉴于轻量级模型的可得性有限,我们把广泛使用和最近发布的较大模型作为质量参考。
评估模型列于Tab。 4 (英语).
我们通过他们的API访问GPT图像2,纳米香蕉2和种子梦5.0 Pro.

blocks.en:
We run open-weight models on NVIDIA A100 GPUs using reference implementations and released checkpoints.
Inference follows the default hyperparameters unless otherwise specified.
We generate one output per sample and use seed 0 where the implementation supports seed control.
We use GPT-4o Hurst et al. (2024) as the primary judge and independently evaluate the same outputs with Gemini 3.1 Pro Google (2026) .
Both judges use identical sample-specific questions and scoring conditions under the protocol in Sec. 4 .
Overall results from both judges are presented in Tab. 4 .
Complete prompts are provided in the Appendix B.2
blocks.zh:
我们在NVIDIA A100GPU上使用参考执行和放行检查站进行开放量的模型.
除非另有说明,推论沿袭默认的超参数。
我们每个样本产生一个输出,使用种子0,其中执行支持种子控制.
我们使用GPT-4o Hurst等人(2024年)作为主裁判,独立评价双子座3.1 Pro Google(2026年)的相同产出.
两位法官都使用相同的样本特定问题和协议下的评分条件。
两名法官的总体结果载于Tab。 4 (英语).
附录B.2提供了完整的提示。

blocks.en:
We evaluate models with fewer than 4B total parameters on an iPhone 17 Pro and a Xiaomi 15 Pro.
To simplify and standardize deployment, we use 4-bit quantization for external text encoders and retain the original checkpoint precision for the remaining components.
For a subset of models, a comparison with the original configurations shows only minor quality differences and unchanged quality tiers after text-encoder quantization (Appendix B.4 ).
The iOS implementation uses Core ML for image-generation components and MLX for external text encoders.
The Android implementation uses ONNX Runtime with the Qualcomm QNN HTP backend for image-generation components and CPU execution for text encoders.
DreamLite is the only evaluated model for which we successfully deployed editing on-device, so we use text-to-image generation as the common deployment task.
Beyond changes required for execution, we introduce no additional model-specific operator or runtime optimizations.
Each successful configuration receives one warm-up run followed by three measured runs.
We report mean end-to-end latency and mean per-run peak memory, sampled every 25 ms.
Models that cannot be deployed on the target device serve as quality references and receive D1.
Results for these configurations are presented in the Tab. 8 .
blocks.zh:
在iPhone 17 Pro和Xiaomi 15 Pro上,我们评价总参数少于4B的模型.
为了简化部署和标准化,我们使用4位的量化来进行外部文本编码,并保留其余组件的原始检查站精度.
对于一个子集模型,与原始配置的比较仅显示在文本编码器四解后微小的质量差异和不变的质量级(附录B.4 ).
iOS的实现使用Core ML作为图像生成组件,MLX作为外部文本编码器.
Android执行使用 ONNX 运行时与 Qualcomm QNN HTP 后端用于图像生成组件和 CPU 执行文本编码器.
DreamLite是我们成功在设备上部署编辑的唯一评价模型,因此我们使用文本到图像生成作为共同的部署任务.
除了执行所需的修改外,我们没有引入额外的模型特定操作员或运行时间优化.
每个成功的配置都得到一次热量运行,然后是三次测量运行。
我们报告是指末端至末端间歇 以及每一次运行的峰值内存 样本每25 ms.
不能部署在目标设备上的模型作为质量参考,并接收D1.
这些配置的结果载于Tab。 8 (英语).

blocks.en:
Tab. 4 reports overall quality and task coverage under both judges.
The three closed-source models reach Q4 and meet the task-quality threshold on all 64 subtasks, while FLUX.2 [klein] leads the open-weight models at Q3.
Among models below 4B total parameters, DreamLite and Ovis-U1 reach Q2.
Ovis-U1 achieves higher overall quality, but DreamLite has higher task coverage under both judges: 0.64 versus 0.59 with GPT-4o, and 0.42 versus 0.38 with Gemini.
Generation-only models ( i.e. , LongCat-Image, SANA, etc. ) remain at Q1 because unsupported editing tasks contribute zero; their overall scores therefore reflect limited coverage of this editing-focused benchmark, not generation quality alone.
blocks.zh:
附表4报告了两名法官的总体质量和任务范围。
三种闭源模型达到了Q4,在所有64个子任务上达到了任务质量阈值,而FLUX.2[klein]则领先于Q3的开量模型.

blocks.en: Higher average quality does not necessarily mean that a model meets the quality threshold on more tasks, making task coverage a complementary consideration for model selection.
blocks.zh: 较高的平均质量并不一定意味着一个模型在更多的任务上达到质量门槛,使任务覆盖成为模型选择的一个补充考虑.

Fig. 3 compares representative outputs across the five operation groups.
DreamLite and Ovis-U1 produce plausible group portraits and visible Lego-style transformations, but neither fully translates the Chinese book title into English, whereas GPT Image 2 produces a readable English title.
In reference editing, DreamLite retains a full-body composition despite the headshot instruction, while Ovis-U1 produces the requested framing but changes the person’s appearance.
Additional qualitative results are provided in the Appendix C.3 .

图3比较了五个行动组的代表性产出。
DreamLite和Ovis-U1制作似似似似组的肖像和可见的乐高风格变换,但两者都没有将中文书名完全翻译成英文,而GPT Image 2则制作可读英文标题.
在参考编辑中,DreamLite尽管头部弹出指令,但仍保留了全身构成,而Ovis-U1则制作所要求的框架,但改变人物的外观.

blocks.en: These examples suggest that compact models need more precise instruction following and better preservation of reference details alongside their generation and stylization capabilities.
blocks.zh: 这些例子表明,紧凑模型需要遵循更精确的指令,并更好地保存参考细节及其生成和分层化能力。

blocks.zh: 5.3 能力分析

blocks.en: Current compact models still lack support for many functions. Broader task support can be an important direction for future development.

blocks.en:
Tab. 6 shows that text and documents remain challenging for both compact and larger open-weight models.
DreamLite and Ovis-U1 score 0.29 and 0.33 in this category, compared with 0.61–0.76 across portrait categories.
The gap also exists among stronger reference models.
For example, FLUX.2 [klein] scores 0.62 on text and documents, compared with 0.94 for Seedream 5.0 Pro and 0.96 for GPT Image 2.

DreamLite和Ovis-U1在这一类中得分分别为0.29和0.33,而肖像类各有0.61–0.76.
这种差距也存在于较强的参照模型中。
例如,FLUX.2 [klein]在文本和文件上得分0.62,而Seedream 5.0 Pro则得分0.94,GPT图像2则得分0.96.

blocks.en: Current on-device models underperform on text handling, facial tasks, and multi-person tasks.
blocks.zh: 目前关于文本处理,面部任务,以及多人任务等的处理模式表现不佳.

blocks.en:
Fig. 5 reveals task-specific differences that operation-level and target-level averages obscure.
Although text and documents receive low aggregate scores, DreamLite and Ovis-U1 achieve 0.66 and 0.71 on text removal, close to FLUX.2 [klein]’s 0.76.
Their scores fall to 0.03 and 0.27 on text replacement, and 0.07 and 0.11 on text addition.

图5显示具体任务的差异,即操作一级和目标一级平均值模糊不清。
虽然文本和文件得到的汇总分数较低,但DreamLite和Ovis-U1在文本去除上实现了0.66和0.71,接近FLUX.2[klein]的0.76.
他们的分数在文本替换上跌至0.03和0.27,在文本添加上跌至0.07和0.11.

blocks.en: These results suggest that limited text-generation capability is the main weakness. And improving replacement therefore requires identifying which content types remain difficult, rather than treating the operation as uniformly weak.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,文本生成能力有限是主要弱点。 因此,改进替换要求确定哪些内容类型仍然困难,而不是将操作视为统一薄弱。

blocks.en:
In reference editing, model performance also varies across targets.
For R1 tasks involving facial features and hairstyles, Ovis-U1 outperforms DreamLite (0.77 versus 0.46), but the ordering reverses for multiple subjects (0.22 versus 0.70).
A single reference-editing or portrait score would conceal this distinction.
Moreover, both models perform well on R1 tasks involving concrete objects and animals, yet neither supports the evaluated base-plus-reference configurations.
Their reference-editing limitations thus involve both quality on particular targets and missing input configurations.
blocks.zh:
在参考编辑中,模型性能也因目标而异.
对于涉及面部特征和发型的R1任务,Ovis-U1优于DreamLite(0.77对0.46),但多个主体的订单反转(0.22对0.70).
单一的参考编辑或肖像记录会掩盖这种区别。
此外,这两种模型在涉及混凝土物体和动物的R1任务上都表现良好,但两者都不支持评价的基数+参考配置.
因此,它们的参考编辑限制涉及特定目标的质量和缺失的投入配置。

blocks.en: The joint analysis helps developers distinguish task-specific quality gaps from missing functionality and supports model selection according to both the requested operation and its target.
blocks.zh: 联合分析帮助开发者区分特定任务的质量差距与缺失的功能,并支持按照请求的操作及其目标选择模型.

blocks.en:
Tab. 7 shows that the gap between on-device and larger models varies across quality requirements.
Ovis-U1 approaches LongCat-Image-Edit in Integrity and Coherence but trails in Selection and Identity, while DreamLite approaches it in Structure but trails in Integrity and Coherence.
These comparisons suggest that preserving image structure or producing visually coherent edits does not ensure accurate target selection or identity preservation.
Identity preservation is also a weakness of some larger models: DeepGen scores 0.65, below DreamLite’s 0.73, despite its higher Fidelity and visual-quality scores.

标签7显示,在设备上与更大的模型之间的差距因质量要求而异。
Ovis-U1在廉正和一致性方面接近LongCat-Image-Edit,但在选择和身份方面则有线索,而DreamLite则在结构方面接近它,但在廉正和一致性方面则有线索。
这些比较表明,保存图像结构或产生视觉连贯的编辑并不能确保准确的目标选择或身份保存。
身份保护也是一些更大模型的弱点:DeepGen在DreamLite的0.73下得分0.65分,尽管它的Fidelity和视觉质量都更高.

blocks.en: On-device model development should go beyond visual quality to improve where edits are applied and whose identity is preserved, while addressing the visual defects that remain in models such as DreamLite.
blocks.zh: 在DreamLite等模型中仍然存在的视觉缺陷。

We vary backbone and decoder precision across FP16, W8A16 and W8A8.
W8A16 and W8A8 use 8-bit weights with 16-bit and 8-bit activations respectively.
We focus on FP16 and W8A16 combinations in Tab. 9 , as W8A8 configurations frequently encounter execution failures or severe visual degradation.
Weight quantization generally reduces model storage, but its latency and memory benefits are less consistent.
For example, Mobile-O runs faster with a W8A16 backbone on Android, while its peak memory increases substantially.
Several configurations that produce recognizable outputs on iOS also fail execution or output-quality checks on Android, indicating that precision choices must be validated for each model and platform.

Tab. 10 shows that fewer generation steps do not necessarily lead to lower total latency.
Mobile-O completes 20 steps faster than DreamLite completes four, owing to its lower per-step cost and lower output resolutions.
Janus-Pro has a low per-token cost, but generating 576 image tokens accounts for approximately 96% of its total latency.

标签10显示,生成步骤较少并不一定导致总延迟度降低.
Mobile-O完成20步比DreamLite完成4步更快,原因是其每步成本较低,输出分辨率较低.

blocks.en: Step distillation and CFG distillation should be prioritized to improve inference efficiency, alongside further optimization of the decoder.
blocks.zh: 步骤蒸馏和CFG蒸馏应优先提高推论效率,同时进一步优化解码器。

blocks.en: 5.5 Q-D analysis.
blocks.zh: 5.5 Q-D分析。

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
Fig. 6 shows that fast mobile inference does not necessarily provide broad task capability.
Mobile-O and DreamLite have similar iOS latency (2.81 and 3.22 s), yet their task coverage differs substantially (0.11 and 0.64), placing them in Q1–D3 and Q2–D3, respectively.
Mobile-O’s low benchmark-wide quality primarily reflects its generation-only scope, highlighting the distinction between efficiently executing a supported task and meeting diverse mobile editing needs.
Ovis-U1 achieves a slightly higher overall quality score than DreamLite (0.66 versus 0.62), but lower task coverage (0.59 versus 0.64), alongside substantially higher latency and peak memory. Thus, a higher average quality score alone does not establish a more useful mobile model.
blocks.zh:
图6显示,快速移动推论不一定提供广泛的任务能力.
Mobile-O和DreamLite具有类似的iOS延时性(2.81和3.22 s),然而它们的任务覆盖面相差很大(0.11和0.64),分别将其置于Q1-D3和Q2-D3中.
Mobile-O的低基准范围质量主要反映了其仅生成范围,突出了高效执行所支持的任务与满足不同的移动编辑需要之间的区别.
Ovis-U1的总质量得分略高于DreamLite(0.66比0.62),但任务覆盖面较低(0.59比0.64),同时耐久性和峰值记忆度也大幅提高. 因此,仅靠提高平均质量分数并不能建立更有用的移动模式。

blocks.en:
These results suggest different development priorities for different starting points.
For efficient generation-only models, a key next step is to support editing while retaining their deployment efficiency.
For models such as DreamLite, priorities include broader input support, particularly multiple reference images, and better editing quality in the weak operation–target combinations identified by our capability analysis.
For Ovis-U1, reducing inference latency and memory demand is necessary to make its existing capabilities more accessible on-device.
Step and CFG distillation, decoder optimization and memory-efficient execution are candidate approaches, whose benefits should be evaluated alongside any changes in output quality. Moving toward the upper-right region of the map therefore requires both broader, more reliable capabilities and lower deployment costs; the evaluated on-device models currently reach neither Q3 nor D4.
blocks.zh:
这些结果表明,不同起点的发展优先事项不同。
对于高效的只生成模式,下一步的关键是支持编辑,同时保持其部署效率.
对于DreamLite等模型来说,优先事项包括更广泛的输入支持,特别是多重参考图像,以及我们的能力分析所确定的弱操作-目标组合中更好的编辑质量。
对Ovis-U1来说,减少推论延迟和内存需求对于使其现有能力更方便在设备上访问是必要的.
步骤和CFG蒸馏、解码器优化和内存效率高的执行是候选办法,其效益应与产出质量的任何变化一并评估。 因此,向地图右上方区域迈进既需要更广泛、更可靠的能力,也需要降低部署费用;目前,评估的安装模型既没有达到问题3,也没有达到D4。

blocks.en:
When model-size constraints limit the capabilities achievable locally, an on-device agent could use the capability profiles to route requests between local models and cloud services.
Routing should depend on the requested operation and target rather than broad application labels.
For example, Ovis-U1 performs comparably to FLUX.2 [klein] on text removal but falls far behind on text replacement, suggesting that these requests may warrant different execution choices. A router could retain locally supported requests that meet the required quality and latency budgets, while sending tasks such as difficult text replacement or unsupported multi-image editing to a more capable cloud model.
Evaluating this task-aware routing strategy is a direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
当模型大小限制限制当地可实现的能力时,一个在线设备可以使用能力剖面,在本地模型和云服务之间传递请求。
排队应当取决于所要求的操作和目标,而不是广泛的应用标签.
例如,Ovis-U1在文本去除上与FLUX.2[klein]具有可比性,但在文本替换上远远落在后面,这表明这些请求可能需要不同的执行选择. 路由器可以保留符合要求的质量和耐用预算的本地支持的请求,同时将困难的文本替换或不支持的多图像编辑等任务发送给更有能力的云模型.
评价这一具有任务意识的路线战略是今后工作的方向。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce MoI-Bench and MoI-Eval to connect users’ needs for image generation and editing on mobile devices with model evaluation and development.
MoI-Bench organizes 64 subtasks along operation and target axes, while MoI-Eval uses task-specific criteria to assess output quality and construct capability profiles.
For users, these profiles help select on-device or cloud models for specific requests, such as makeup removal or text replacement.
For researchers, they identify unsupported tasks or unmet quality requirements, providing directions for expanding model capabilities and improving quality.
The Quality × \times Deployability map complements this analysis with mobile latency, storage and memory costs, helping developers assess which capabilities are practical to offer locally.
Together, this framework supports evaluating image models by how well they meet users’ needs and guides the development of more capable and accessible image AI across mobile and cloud platforms.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍MoI-Bench和MoI-Eval,将用户在移动设备上的图像生成和编辑需求与模型评价和发展联系起来。
MoI-Bench沿着运行和目标轴组织64个子任务,而MoI-Eval则使用任务特定标准来评估输出质量和构造能力剖面.
对于用户来说,这些配置文件帮助选择用于特定请求的在线设备或云模型,如化妆去除或文本替换.
对于研究人员来说,他们确定了未得到支持的任务或未达到的质量要求,为扩大模型能力及提高质量提供了方向.
质量 ×\times 部署可操作性地图以移动延迟、存储和内存成本来补充这一分析,帮助开发人员评估哪些能力是实用的,可以在当地提供。
这个框架共同支持通过图像模型如何很好地满足用户的需求来评价图像模型,并指导移动和云平台上更有能力和更容易获取的图像AI的发展.

blocks.en: B.1 Task-Specific Rubrics and Criterion Applicability

blocks.en:
A criterion specifies a quality requirement for an output.
MoI-Eval defines eight criteria under instruction following (IF), visual quality (VQ) and detail preservation (DP) (Tab. 15 ).
Preservation applies only to content or attributes not targeted by the instruction.
blocks.zh:
一个标准规定了对产出的质量要求。
MoI-Eval在指令下定义了八个标准,分别遵循(IF),视觉质量(VQ)和细节保存(DP)(Tab. 15).
保护仅适用于该指令未针对的内容或属性.

blocks.zh: 表15:八项评价标准的定义。

blocks.en:
Each entry ( o , t , c ) (o,t,c) defines criterion c c for operation o o and target t t .
For example, Fidelity checks text removal or correct replacement text, depending on the operation.
For person removal, Identity checks the remaining people.
These requirements guide sample-grounded questions.

blocks.en:
We manually label each rubric entry as: • Always applicable. Required for every sample in the subtask, such as Fidelity in text replacement. • Sample-dependent. Determined by the instruction and input images. For example, Identity applies to object editing when people must remain unchanged. • Not applicable. Excluded from the subtask. For example, text-to-image generation has no source content to preserve, so DP is excluded. We include always-applicable criteria and resolve sample-dependent criteria for each sample.
The selected criteria determine its questions and criterion groups.

B.3 Additional Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: B.3 额外的实验设置

blocks.en:
Text-to-image generation uses each model’s default resolution; wallpaper prompts use a 9 : 16 9{:}16 aspect ratio.
Non-outpainting editing requests use the base-image dimensions unless another canvas size is specified.
Outpainting requests use a 1:1 canvas by default unless the instruction specifies another size or aspect ratio.
Each pipeline retains its native preprocessing and resolution constraints.
Editing outputs are not resized after generation, except for judge preprocessing.
blocks.zh:
文本到图像生成使用每个模型的默认分辨率;壁纸提示使用9:16 9{}16个宽比.
非外绘编辑请求使用基像尺寸,除非指定另一个画布大小.
外绘请求默认使用 1: 1 画布, 除非指令指定了另一个大小或宽比 。
每条管道都保留其本土的预处理和分辨率限制。
除法官预处理外,编辑产出不会在生成后调整规模。

blocks.en:
Both judges use identical preprocessing.
We resize input and output images to a maximum side length of 1,024 pixels with bicubic interpolation, preserving aspect ratios without upscaling.
Images are converted to RGB and encoded as JPEG at quality 88.
This affects only judge inputs, not saved model outputs.
blocks.zh:
两位法官使用相同的预处理.
我们将输入和输出图像的大小调整到最大侧长为1,024像素的双立方插值,在不升级的情况下保留了侧面比.
图像转换为RGB,并在质量88时编码为JPEG.
这只影响到判断投入,而不是节省模型产出。

blocks.en:
Deployment tests use the prompt: “A cinematic portrait of a young woman surrounded by flowers, soft natural light.”
Within each model, the prompt, seed, resolution and sampling settings remain fixed across precision configurations.
The Android Janus-Pro deployment uses precomputed prompt embeddings, and its reported latency excludes prompt preparation.
Loading or offloading performed during generation remains part of measured end-to-end latency.
Failed configurations are excluded from successful-run averages.
Some precision configurations also change session partitioning or resource management, as noted in Tab. 9 ; their timing differences cannot be attributed to precision alone.
The backbone and decoder precision experiments in Tab. 9 do not repeat the full benchmark quality evaluation, and recognizable outputs do not establish quality retention.

blocks.en:
We assess the effect of 4-bit NF4 text-encoder quantization on Ovis-U1-3B, DreamLite and SANA-600M.
